features.label: Course map sign
features.note: [G3 Course layout map] Course layout map sign at the park entrance, on the walk from the parking lot to hole 1.

features.label: Bench
features.note: [G6 Benches] Bench at the start and finish, between the hole 9 basket and hole 1 tee, near parking.

features.label: Bench
features.note: [G6 Benches] Mid-round rest area between the hole 5 basket and the hole 6 tees.

features.label: Bench
features.note: [G6 Benches] Rest area at the hole 7 long tee, after the long walk to the course's far corner.

features.label: Class 5 path
features.note: [G2 Safe traversing] Class 5 gravel connection from the parking lot to the hole 1 tee and map sign, about 40 ft. Firm surface for the busiest entry point.

features.label: Woodchip path
features.note: [G2 Safe traversing] Woodchip walkway, about 185 ft, from hole 1 basket to hole 2 tees (W). Volunteer install.

features.label: Woodchip path
features.note: [G2 Safe traversing] Woodchip walkway, about 160 ft, from hole 5 basket to hole 6 tees (E). Volunteer install.

features.label: Woodchip path
features.note: [G2 Safe traversing] Woodchip walkway, about 170 ft, from hole 6 basket to hole 7 tees (SW). Check the slope on site; use timber stairs if the grade is too steep for woodchips. Volunteer install.

features.label: Class 5 path
features.note: [G2 Safe traversing] Class 5 gravel walkway, about 205 ft, from hole 7 basket to hole 8 tees (N). Open, high-use stretch along the east side. Volunteer install.
